hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */web/.env.example|*/worker/.env.example) pkg="${f%/.env.example}"; pkg="${pkg##*/}"; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"%s/.env.example was just edited. Review %s/.env and make the same change there unless the divergence is intentional: the two files are kept identical apart from their values."}}' "$pkg" "$pkg";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
